app: FlatDesk: Zendesk alternative with AI included at a flat price (built on Chatwoot)

personas.role: Tier-1 support agent at a 7-agent Shopify brand
personas.cares_about: Closing tickets fast with good CSAT so the queue never runs away; hitting first-response SLA.
personas.time_spent: Most of the day in the inbox: reading tickets, looking up orders in Shopify, typing the same 'where is my order' answers.
personas.struggles: Switching between the helpdesk and Shopify admin for every order question; repetitive answers; AI drafts that don't know the order or promise things nobody did.
personas.how_helps: AI-drafted reply filled with the live order and tracking, customer context in the right bar, and one button that does the action (replacement, claim, refund) and sends.

tasks.name: As Agent (Maya), only my tabs and my queue show
expect: [data-testid='role-note']:has-text('Hidden for this role: Migration, Billing, Admin')

tasks.name: Open Daniel's over-limit ticket: context is his, and sending needs a lead
expect: [data-testid='policy-check']:has-text("Needs a lead's approval: $112 is over the $100 limit")

tasks.name: Request approval: the ticket waits, and the agent cannot delete customer data
Macros match the ticket's intent only
expect: #reply-box:has-text('Want me to pause it for you?')

tasks.name: A 22-month subscriber shows her real order count
Search opens the right conversation with its customer

personas.cares_about: SLA compliance, balanced workload, coaching agents.
personas.time_spent: Watching the queue, reassigning tickets, chasing breaches, weekly 1:1s.
personas.struggles: No single view of tickets about to breach; finds out after the fact; reassigning blind.
personas.how_helps: An 'SLA at risk' view with live timers, a defined threshold and today's breach count; a picker that preselects the lowest-load agent; workload by agent that matches the inbox.

tasks.name: As Team lead (Jordan), start in the SLA view with arithmetic that adds up
An agent's over-limit request reaches the lead's notifications
expect: [data-testid='policy-check']:has-text('Requested from Jordan P. by Maya R.')

tasks.name: Approve: replacement created, reply sent as Maya, approval logged
expect: .thread .msg.event:has-text('Approved by Jordan P. (requested by Maya R.')

tasks.name: Reassign to the lowest-load online agent
Coaching: per-agent QA, reopen and first reply, with 1:1 samples
Opening a breach from notifications keeps the SLA view

personas.cares_about: CSAT, cost per conversation, headcount plan, what share the AI resolves, and a story for the board.
personas.time_spent: Reports, vendor reviews, planning peak-season staffing.
personas.struggles: Zendesk AI billed per resolution makes cost unpredictable; can't prove AI quality isn't hurting CSAT; can't show the board savings.
personas.how_helps: Reports with one shared period, AI vs human CSAT with sample sizes, reopen rate, software cost per conversation, savings vs a hedged Zendesk estimate, a 12-week trend and an 8-week peak forecast.

tasks.name: As Head of CX (Dana), the board overview leads with savings vs the real Zendesk bill
The right bar fits the board page, not the live queue
One period selector drives Reports and AI
Billing is a read-only summary for this role
Export the board summary

personas.cares_about: Predictable software spend; no surprise invoices; renewal terms; budget vs actual.
personas.time_spent: Month-end close, approving vendor bills, budget vs actual.
personas.struggles: Per-resolution AI fees and seat hikes make the helpdesk bill swing month to month; paying two vendors during a switch.
personas.how_helps: Flat bill with a clear rule above fair use, a hedged Zendesk comparison, the transition-month overlap, invoices, terms, plan ladder and a 12-month projection.

tasks.name: As Finance (Theo): November bill, savings vs actual spend, transition month reconciled
Fair use is a contract term with a choice, and seats warn before the next tier
12-month projection against actual and renewal Zendesk costs, with the post-lock price
Invoices show seats used vs included; terms link the fair-use clause
Finance is notified at 9 of 10 seats

personas.cares_about: Revenue, repeat purchases, not losing sales to slow replies, and not wasting a week on a migration before peak season.
personas.time_spent: Everywhere; checks support when something breaks.
personas.struggles: Fear that switching helpdesks loses ticket history and breaks things right before Black Friday.
personas.how_helps: Migration tab shows a dated, completed summary with proof (spot-check), a named contact, rollback plan, next actions with owners and a peak-readiness checklist; Reports show revenue in open tickets.

tasks.name: As Owner (Hana): migration summary with proof numbers and the open peak item
Spot-check that history arrived intact
See exactly who got the DNS instructions
Revenue: repeat orders after support, revenue kept, savings vs actual spend
expect: [data-testid='kpi-repeat']:has-text('Orders within 7 days of a support reply')

personas.cares_about: SSO, access control, data ownership, compliance evidence, being able to leave.
personas.time_spent: User provisioning, security reviews, vendor questionnaires.
personas.struggles: Lock-in, unclear data location and AI processing; exporting from Zendesk was painful.
personas.how_helps: Admin shows enforced SSO, SCIM, roles, regions, backups, scoped scheduled exports, compliance documents, AI processing and an audit log.

tasks.name: As IT (Raj): SSO and the security right bar
Turn on the IP allowlist and sign Sam out everywhere
Full audit log: filter, export, SIEM stream
SOC 2 Type II date and a bridge letter
Rules are read-only for IT (separation of duties)
The rail gear is labelled Admin

personas.role: Ops manager serving Spanish-speaking customers on WhatsApp
personas.cares_about: Answering customers in their channel and language; fewer missed messages.
personas.time_spent: Juggling a separate WhatsApp phone and the helpdesk.
personas.struggles: WhatsApp lives outside the helpdesk; translations are manual; the 24h window rule causes failed sends.
personas.how_helps: WhatsApp is a channel with unread and waiting counts, a 24h-window timer, templates when it closes, translations under every message and draft, and drafts that only claim actions that were done.

tasks.name: As WhatsApp ops (Rosa): WhatsApp view with counts from the same set
Open Lucía: the 24h window runs from her last message
Translations of message and draft
Open the claim and send: the window does not restart on our reply
A closed window shows a filled-in template preview

personas.cares_about: Deflection: more questions answered by the AI and articles.
personas.time_spent: Writing and updating articles; reviewing what customers ask.
personas.struggles: Doesn't know which questions the AI fails on or what it said.
personas.how_helps: AI agent tab lists gaps for the shared period with sample conversations and handoff reasons in the right bar, an in-place editor that publishes to help centre and AI, and deflection metrics.

tasks.name: As Knowledge (Kai): open gaps and the selected gap
Samples follow the period
Publish: the gap moves to Fixed and the open count drops
Reply to the open conversation that asked it
Self-serve rate is defined by sessions, not views

personas.cares_about: Routing, automations and macros that keep handle time down and the AI behaving safely; a clean cutover with no lost triggers.
personas.time_spent: Building triggers, views, SLAs, macros and integrations; fixing broken automations after changes.
personas.struggles: Zendesk triggers/automations and app integrations don't map 1:1 on migration; AI rules are a black box.
personas.how_helps: A Rules page that shows each migrated Zendesk trigger/SLA policy next to its FlatDesk equivalent, plus AI guardrails and handoff rules they can edit and test.

tasks.name: As Support ops (Nina): migrated objects with changed meanings flagged
Test a changed trigger on a sample
Change the guardrail to $150 and save
expect: [data-testid='guard-edit']:has-text("Refunds or replacements over $150 need a lead's approval")

tasks.name: Open tickets are re-checked under the new limit
The AI tab shows the same rule

personas.cares_about: Reply quality and brand voice from both humans and the AI; fewer wrong promises and refunds.
personas.time_spent: Sampling and scoring conversations, writing feedback, running onboarding for new agents.
personas.struggles: No easy way to sample AI replies and see where it promised something wrong.
personas.how_helps: An AI review queue with random samples, a scorecard and 'fix the answer' that feeds the AI's knowledge.

tasks.name: As QA (Quinn): the review queue with a per-criterion scorecard and pass rate
Score five AI replies; fail Mei's on one criterion
Save the correction and send Mei the corrected reply
Sample human replies too; feedback feeds the lead's coaching
Agent QA in Reports includes the new score

personas.cares_about: GDPR/CCPA compliance, DPAs, data deletion requests, AI processing disclosures.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing vendor contracts, handling access and deletion requests, maintaining records of processing.
personas.struggles: Can't confirm where helpdesk and AI data is processed or delete a customer everywhere.
personas.how_helps: Admin shows DPA, subprocessors, AI provider and training policy; the customer card has a confirm step to delete or export that customer, covering conversations and AI logs, recorded in the audit log.

tasks.name: As Privacy (Pat): the request register, retention and transfer basis
Set automatic retention
One document name everywhere, no mock wording
Deletion needs an identity check and warns about open work
Verify and delete: the customer is redacted everywhere
The register shows the completed, verified request
expect: [data-testid='dsr-DSR-012']:has-text('Verified: request came from the email on file')

personas.cares_about: Converting café and office inquiries into accounts quickly.
personas.struggles: Wholesale leads arrive in the support inbox and get answered late or by the AI with the wrong info.
personas.how_helps: 'Route to sales' sends the lead to a Sales inbox with SLA and CRM sync; the AI tags B2B intent and never quotes wholesale prices.

tasks.name: As Sales (Carla): only the Sales inbox, and only her notifications
Routed lead with sales-only macros
Reply with the price list: the CRM deal is named with value and stage
Nothing else needs her now

personas.cares_about: Subscription churn, repeat purchase, reviews and Instagram DM sentiment.
personas.time_spent: Analyzing churn reasons, running win-back flows, managing social inboxes.
personas.struggles: Cancel reasons and product complaints are buried in tickets.
personas.how_helps: Reports tag contact reasons with trends and track how many cancel requests a pause offer saved, with revenue kept.

tasks.name: As Marketing (Mara): reasons with deltas and trends, saves at real prices, tone by channel
Drill into cancel requests and export for win-back
Switch to the last 7 days: compared with the week before

personas.cares_about: Fewer mis-picks and damaged shipments; fast replacements.
personas.time_spent: Managing pick/pack, carrier claims and replacement orders.
personas.struggles: Hears about wrong grind or ripped bags only when finance sees refunds.
personas.how_helps: Auto-tagged fulfilment issues with order/SKU/carrier counts for the period, a weekly digest, and links into the conversation.

tasks.name: As Fulfilment (Felix): rates per 1,000 shipped, split by fault owner
Last 7 days: send mis-picks to the 3PL and file carrier claims
Open an issue's conversation (read-only) and come back
Back to the report

personas.role: Vendor manager at an outsourced support company (ShiftCX)
personas.cares_about: Meeting contracted SLAs with a shared seat pool and clear billing.
personas.time_spent: Scheduling shifts across clients, monitoring queues.
personas.struggles: Seat-based pricing and per-client access separation.
personas.how_helps: Flat plan with agent groups and restricted access per inbox and hours; seat use is visible before inviting.

tasks.name: As Owner, add an outsourced agent with a schedule; the seat-tier warning shows first
Create it with a time zone
As Vendor (ShiftCX), see only the Overflow SLA report
Share the vendor SLA report
The vendor's inbox is only the Overflow queue

personas.cares_about: Contract terms that avoid another renewal trap: price caps, exit rights, uptime SLA with credits, vendor risk.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing order forms, negotiating renewals, tracking contract dates and vendor risk files.
personas.struggles: Zendesk auto-renewed annually with a seat increase; uptime and support commitments are buried in long MSAs.
personas.how_helps: A Contract page with the signed order form, renewal date and cap, notice deadline reminders, uptime SLA with credit history and status page, and exit/data-return terms.

tasks.name: As Procurement (Paul): renewal cap, uptime SLA and exit terms
Set a notice reminder
Vendor risk documents
The reminder shows in procurement's notifications

personas.cares_about: Reliable integrations (Shopify, Slack, CRM, 3PL), webhooks and API limits; nothing breaks silently after the migration.
personas.time_spent: Maintaining webhooks, API scripts and app integrations; debugging failed syncs.
personas.struggles: Zendesk apps did not carry over (the Slack angry-customer alert needs review); no visibility into failed webhook deliveries.
personas.how_helps: An Integrations page with each connected app's health, webhook builder with test payloads and delivery log, API keys with scopes and rate limits.

tasks.name: As Integrations (Ivan): app health, delivery log and API limits
Replace the Slack trigger with a webhook: test, then save
The Rules page shows the trigger mapped and a passing test

personas.cares_about: Product defects and confusing product information that drive contacts and returns; roadmap input from customers.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing returns, reviews and feedback; updating product pages and packaging.
personas.struggles: Product questions (12% of contacts) and complaints like 'decaf Swiss Water?' are buried in tickets and never reach product owners.
personas.how_helps: A product-feedback report by SKU (questions, defects, return reasons) with example quotes, trends and a link to fix the product page or packaging.

tasks.name: As Product (Pia): questions and defects by SKU
Flag the decaf page conflict to its owner
Jump to the matching AI gap

personas.cares_about: Right staffing per hour across channels and time zones, especially for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
personas.time_spent: Building shift schedules, forecasting by hour, managing time-off and BPO overflow.
personas.struggles: The forecast is weekly only; no intraday arrivals by channel; shift coverage and the AI's share are not modelled together.
personas.how_helps: An hourly forecast by channel after AI deflection, coverage against scheduled shifts (including Overflow), with gaps highlighted.

tasks.name: As Workforce (Wes): Black Friday hour by hour after AI, with gaps
Filter to chat and switch to Cyber Monday
